message.content: {"caption":"Diagram comparing sequential skill-bank updates with parallel distillation of lessons from multiple traces.","description":"Two-part process diagram. On the left, a sequence of traces (Trace1, Trace2, Trace3, …, TraceN) feeds into successive skill-bank versions (v1, v2, v3, …, vN), with arrows indicating updates after each trace. On the right, the traces are grouped in a pool and processed in parallel; patch icons are combined through branching and merging steps into a single distilled skill. A legend distinguishes a skill patch from a patch merge.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
